newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint eases vs dlr, firms vs NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint eases vs dlr, firms vs NBH basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed a little weaker against the dollar on Wednesday but was virtually back on the central bank's resistance level, dealers said.
The forint finished at 185.12/17 to the dollar, compared to 185.05/10 at opening.

At the close the Hungarian forint was some two pips off the central bank's resistance level amid currency purchases on the market, due to which the forint distanced itself some some five pips from the bid during morning trade, dealers said.
At midday the forint was stuck at the central bank's resistance level but at the pening it was five pips weaker.
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
